component.name: pvr2png
component.summary: Convert PowerVR and Sega Dreamcast textures to PNG

description.p: pvr2png converts PowerVR (PVR v1, v2, and v3), Apple PVRTC, and Sega Dreamcast textures and texture packs to PNG files.
It decodes uncompressed textures, PVRTC, DXT1 to DXT5, BC1 to BC5, YUV, twiddled and VQ Dreamcast textures, and palettised Dreamcast textures with their palettes.
